description: This file defines the Java class `IntegrationConfiguration`, which models external gateway integration settings, including properties like module code, environment, activation status, and associated keys and options. It implements JSON serialization via Jackson and JSONSimple libraries.

classes.name: IntegrationConfiguration
classes.description: Java class representing configuration details for external gateway integrations, including environment, activation, keys, options, and JSON serialization methods.

methods.name: getModuleCode
methods.description: Returns the module code associated with the integration configuration.

methods.name: setModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the module code for the integration configuration.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks whether the integration configuration is active.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active status for the integration configuration.

methods.name: getIntegrationKeys
methods.description: Retrieves the map of integration keys.

methods.name: setIntegrationKeys
methods.description: Sets the map of integration keys.

methods.name: getJsonInfo
methods.description: Builds a partial JSON string representing key properties of the object.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the entire object, including nested keys and options, into a JSON string.

methods.name: setEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the environment type (e.g., TEST or PRODUCTION).

methods.name: getIntegrationOptions
methods.description: Gets the map of integration options.

methods.name: setIntegrationOptions
methods.description: Sets the map of integration options.

methods.name: isDefaultSelected
methods.description: Checks if the configuration is marked as default selected.

methods.name: setDefaultSelected
methods.description: Sets whether the configuration is default selected.
